story.fullStory:
Chaka Khan's "I Feel For You" reached #3 on the Billboard Hot 100. "I Feel for You" is a song written by American musician Prince that originally appeared on his 1979 self-titled album.

The most successful and best-known version was recorded by R&B singer Chaka Khan and appeared on her 1984 album of the same name.

It became the recipient of two Grammy Awards for Best R&B Song (with Prince as its songwriter) and Best Female R&B Vocal Performance for Khan.

The song peaked at #3 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 26 weeks on the chart.
